archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) with Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) influences

brand_identity.name: Dazzle Dental & Cosmetic Studio
brand_identity.tagline: Dental & Cosmetic Studio — Teeth | Skin | Hair

typography.h1: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight text-brand-navy leading-tight
typography.overline: font-sans text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-brand-teal

hero.layout: Overlapping layout with a split view. Left side: typography, overline, H1, tagline, dual CTAs. Right side: large high-res image with elegant rounded corners or abstract shape mask.
hero.decorations: Subtle grain texture, floating brand-teal blurred blobs for a premium cosmetic vibe.

services_section.layout: Grid layout. Instead of traditional cards, use large visual blocks (images) with text overlaid at the bottom using a glassmorphism gradient (bg-gradient-to-t from-brand-navy/80 to-transparent).

booking_form.style: Clean, editorial layout. Wrap the form in a bg-white container with shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(31,78,121,0.08)] and rounded-3xl. Use Shadcn inputs with border-b-2 border-brand-sand bg-transparent instead of full borders for a lightweight aesthetic.

navigation.style: Sticky crystal glass header. backdrop-blur-xl bg-brand-light/80 border-b border-brand-navy/5. Links must use font-sans, uppercase, text-sm tracking-widest.

buttons.primary: bg-brand-navy text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-brand-teal transition-colors duration-300 font-sans tracking-wide uppercase text-sm
buttons.secondary: border border-brand-navy text-brand-navy px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-brand-navy hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 font-sans tracking-wide uppercase text-sm
buttons.whatsapp: fixed bottom-8 right-8 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform z-50 flex items-center justify-center

animations.scroll: Use Framer Motion's `whileInView` for gentle fade-up (y: 30 to y: 0) and opacity (0 to 1) with easeOut, duration: 0.8.
animations.page_load: Curtain reveal for the hero image (clip-path expansion).

hero_main.description: Premium modern dental clinic interior used in hero section.

service_teeth.description: Smiling woman with perfect teeth for Teeth Service card.

service_skin.description: Luxurious skincare treatment for Skin Service card.

service_hair.description: Beautiful healthy hair portrait for Hair Service card.

about_clinic.description: Modern clinic showcasing clean and trusted medical environment.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for styling and Framer Motion for interactive animations.
Implement the Playfair Display font for all Headings (H1, H2) and Outfit for body and button texts.
Strictly follow the color palette. Backgrounds should be off-white/pearl (#FDFDFB), and buttons/CTAs should utilize the brand navy (#1F4E79) and teal (#5BA9A8).
Build an interactive booking form using Shadcn Input, Select, and Button components, maintaining the lightweight border-bottom style.
Do NOT use standard card components for services. Use visual bento grids with large imagery and elegant glassmorphism overlays for text.
Ensure the sticky header has a backdrop blur.
Implement a floating WhatsApp button in the bottom right corner.
Include a 'Testimonials' section and 'Before/After' gallery utilizing grid layouts.
Include `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, forms, links) using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., `data-testid='booking-submit-button'`).
